description: CR-002 (Required for Phase 2, incl. Amendment A): research egress for GitHub user content, egress modes allowlist/research/open (default open), Hermes capability tiers locked/research/self_improve (default self_improve) with Telegram-approved skills, and Hermes as the user's general multimodal assistant behind the gatekeeper (routing, attachments, EXIF stripping, vision role, streamed replies, /new, /quiet, /notify, per-feature plugin stores), plus the CR-002 live research checks (phase2-plan.md items 16-20). The invariants no mode relaxes stay exactly as Phase 1 built them (IP literals, denied_dst, vsock/io_uring, DNS, Hyper-V, gatekeeper/runner egress, fetch/validate allowlists, key-exfil probes and output key scans). Depends on FEAT-005 (relay), FEAT-006 (models.yaml vision role, sandbox research jobs) and FEAT-007 (Hermes install, config template, plugin, surface check).
steps: Item 16: egress data and modes (CR-002 req 1, 2, 6). config/egress.yaml: move .github.io, gist.github.com, gist.githubusercontent.com from always_denied.domains to a new category github_user_content granted to the research profile and host caller hermes (3141); uploads.github.com stays always-denied; add a 'why' comment per remaining always-denied name. Add modes: allowlist (named categories only, no web_public anywhere), research (today + github_user_content), open (research + web_public for agent-llm AND catalog, because they share the llm pool and the renderer refuses pool-mates with different categories - VERIFICATION.md CR-002 note); fetch and validate never get web_public in any mode; gatekeeper/runner host_callers identical in every mode (a renderer assertion, not data). Mode state: config default egress.yaml 'mode_default: open' via the snapshot, the active mode in /var/lib/ossbot/control/egress-mode (JSON {mode, actor, ts}; gatekeeper:osscontrol; unparseable -> allowlist, fail closed). Changing it: Telegram /egress <mode> (go: two-tap confirm) and 'ossctl egress mode <mode>' (TTY confirm) -> gatekeeper writes the flag, audits, FYIs -> root systemd/ossbot-egress.path + ossbot-egress-apply.service -> scripts/bin/ossbot-egress-apply re-renders squid via ossbot.ctl.render for the snapshot + mode and reconfigures the proxy container; 'ossbot-firewall --check' / watchdog compare the running squid conf with the render for the current mode. Update the squid golden(s) per mode (tests/unit/ctl/golden/squid.<mode>.conf), tests/unit/ctl/test_render.py (every mode: invariants identical; fetch/validate never web_public; agent-llm web_public only in open), and tests/system/test_egress_surface.sh (hermes raw CONNECT to x.github.io./gist.github.com. now 200-class through 3141 in research/open; code-running profiles still 403) plus a new tests/sandbox case: research profile 200 on a known *.github.io page and a public gist (raw too), fetch/validate/agent-llm(non-open) 403. Update DESIGN §11.3 and the ADR-0005 addendum (CR-002 wins).

Item 17: Hermes capability tiers (CR-002 req 3, 6). Tier state in /var/lib/ossbot/control/hermes-tier (default from policy.yaml hermes.capability_tier_default: self_improve; unparseable -> locked). hermes/config/config.yaml.j2 renders per tier: locked = FEAT-007 allowlist; research = + Hermes-native web tools only if v0.22.2 routes them through HTTPS_PROXY 3141 (verify; otherwise research = locked + Kiro web tools and record it); self_improve = research + skills (skill_manage, skill_view, skills_list). terminal, code_execution, file, browser, delegation, cronjob stay disabled in every tier; memory on in all. The gatekeeper surface check (chat/hermes_surface.py) uses the tier's allowlist; mismatch is still a soft kill. Switching: Telegram /hermes tier <tier> (go, two-tap) and 'ossctl hermes tier <tier>' -> flag -> root ossbot-hermes-tier.path/.service re-renders ~hermes/.hermes/config.yaml as root (O_NOFOLLOW, refuse symlinks), restarts ossbot-hermes, re-runs the hermes-side probe and the surface check before the relay reopens. Skills gate: verify how v0.22.2 loads skills (directories, external dirs, write location). Hermes writes new/changed skills only to a staging dir; the gatekeeper detects them (root-run hasher via the probe socket or a root timer writing /var/lib/ossbot/skills/pending.json) and sends a skill card (escaped diff in <pre>, [Approve] [Reject], same two-tap single-use message-bound tokens: purposes skill_approve, skill_confirm, skill_reject; table skill_reviews in migration 0003_cr002.sql); on Confirm root copies the skill into the read-only active dir (root:hermes 0750 dirs, 0640 files), records sha256; doctor detects drift; a skill can never grant tools above the tier (the config, not the skill, defines toolsets). If v0.22.2 cannot keep staging and active apart, do NOT ship an ungated skills tier: stop and send_message severity 'warning' describing the gap and the alternative (self_improve degraded to research until fixed).

Item 18: general assistant (CR-002 Amendment A item 7). Routing in telegram/handlers.py: commands -> registry; pending_input replies -> FEAT-005 flows; everything else -> Hermes: free text, photos/albums, documents, voice, locations, replies to earlier bot messages (quoted context passed along). src/ossbot/gatekeeper/chat/attachments.py: download via getFile through the gatekeeper's proxy (3150 must allow the Telegram file host; check egress data), size cap default 20 MB and type allowlist (images, PDF, text, audio) from policy.yaml chat.attachments, EXIF/GPS stripped from images by default (Pillow pinned ==, re-encode without metadata; toggle chat.attachments.strip_exif), stored under a per-conversation dir /srv/ossbot/chat/<session>/ readable by hermes (group, 0750/0640), passed to Hermes by path or as input content per the Hermes API [VERIFY]; the adapter sends images as ACP image content blocks only when promptCapabilities.image is true (FEAT-007 finding) and switches to the 'vision' role model; voice -> pass audio if supported, else reply 'voice isn't supported yet'. UX: typing indicator (sendChatAction) while waiting; streamed replies by editing one message progressively at <= 1 edit/s per chat (Hermes streaming [VERIFY]; fallback: single message); long answers split cleanly; Hermes markdown via chat/markdown.py on escaped text; sources listed as links when web tools were used; /new (alias of /newchat; memory persists); OSS notifications and cards keep a distinct header prefix ('🧩 ossbot' / '🤖'); /quiet and /notify set OSS FYI verbosity (stored in DB, honoured by the outbox notify path; approval cards are never suppressed). Extensibility: hermes/plugins/ossbot gains a feature registry where each feature has its own SQLite store under /home/hermes/.hermes/ossbot-features/<feature>.db; ship one reference feature 'nutrition_log' (add entry, list day, daily totals); code execution is only via an ossbot plugin request for a research/agent-llm sandbox job scheduled by the gatekeeper, never in-process. Reverse image search: documented optional secret hook in scripts/setup-secrets.{ps1,sh} (e.g. IMAGE_SEARCH_API_KEY, skipped when empty) + a skill stub; no provider implemented without a user decision. Tests: tests/telegram/test_routing.py (every message type), tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_attachments.py (cap, type allowlist, EXIF/GPS removed, path confinement), tests/telegram/test_streaming.py (fake-Hermes streaming, edit rate limit), tests/unit/hermes_plugin/test_features.py.
Item 19: redeploy (bootstrap -Only provision twice; second run only 'unchanged'), run the hermetic bar, ROOTDEV pytest -m "sandbox or e2e_docker", every tests/system/*.sh.

Item 20: LIVE checks (CR-002 req 4 + Amendment A tests), results in docs/VERIFICATION.md '## Phase 2 live checks': through POST /v1/chat/selftest (extend it to accept a fixture attachment) send (a) a question that needs current web info -> sourced answer; confirm in the proxy log that the Kiro web_search/web_fetch traffic went through 3141 (or document that Kiro's web tools run server-side and what that means for egress control); (b) a github.io page and a public gist fetched from the research profile and from Hermes; (c) the food-photo check with a public-domain fixture image under tests/fixtures/ (record the estimate; accuracy is not graded); answers go to the configured user's Telegram only. Default mode open and tier self_improve are active and shown by /status and doctor. Set status completed, write findings (mode/tier mechanics, skills dirs, attachment dir layout for backups, Hermes streaming support), commit locally.
acceptance_criteria: DEV pytest -m "unit or telegram or acp or e2e" passes incl. test_render.py per-mode cases, test_routing.py, test_attachments.py, test_streaming.py and the skill-gate tests (skill inactive until two-tap approval; drift detected)

Every egress mode keeps the Phase 1 invariants byte-identical in the render (IP literals, denied_dst, DNS, gatekeeper/runner callers); fetch/validate never get web_public; research and hermes reach github.io and gists; code-running profiles get 403 (sandbox + system tests)

Tier switch re-renders Hermes config as root, restarts Hermes and reruns probe + surface check; terminal/code_execution/file/browser/delegation/cronjob absent in every tier; surface mismatch soft-kills
Mode and tier changes need the two-tap confirm, are audited and FYI'd; defaults open/self_improve active after bootstrap
Live research, github.io/gist and food-photo checks recorded in docs/VERIFICATION.md (or the blocking key/tool issue recorded in docs/FINAL_REPORT.md)
